question: How are fixed IL-1 component transcripts detected and co-detected in candidate epithelial nuclei, especially original paired LUAD versus normal patients?
decision: Distinguish detection frequency, positive-cell intensity and candidate-selection/depth dependence behind exposed aggregate IL1RAP-up and IL1R1-down observations.
strongest_rival: Depth, ambient RNA, cell mixture and healthy-reference label/confidence selection, including mapping-feature overlap, can change candidate barcode RNA without intrinsic within-state regulation.
discriminator: Separate fixed-gene detection, positive-cell intensity, four joint barcode categories and prespecified confidence, depth and equal-block sensitivities; no functional or independent-state discriminator is available.
exposure_record: Exposed old predictions, whole-cohort diagnostics, component means and Peng source results. New cell-level target distributions have not been calculated before this freeze. File format, two annotation metadata rows, headers and source roster were inspected; complete source bytes were hashed without endpoint calculation.
biological_unit: Patient; original twelve matched patients primary, all 23 source patient labels broader descriptive context.
nesting_and_overlap: 75 libraries and nuclei nested within 23 patients; repeated histology blocks pooled, equal-block sensitivity. Same GSE308103 lineage as old A12 and Peng, not independent validation.
population_and_selection: Exact primary twelve original patients, AT2 finest label uncertainty<=0.2 and >=50 pooled QC nuclei per normal/LUAD unit. Four fixed candidate-selection sensitivities; all-QC label inventory and broader all-histology description. See frozen specification.
contrast: Primary LUAD-minus-normal in the twelve original patients. Broader histologies are descriptive tables only; no expanded favorable contrast search.
endpoint: Ten fixed per-gene detection fractions, positive-cell log2(1+10000 counts/full-library) intensities and pseudobulk parity; four fixed IL1R1/context pairs, primary IL1R1/IL1RAP joint detection.
methods: Read custom CSC gene pointers and source_cell_index joins; verify stored QC/barcodes/denominators. Pool blocks, report patient deltas and leave-one-patient-out mean ranges. Fixed 4x4 depth/gene-count bins with >=5 cells per histology for common-support standardization. All detailed choices in PUBLIC_CELLS_SPEC_V1.md.
missingness_and_exclusions: Absent/duplicate target or source/QC/parity conflict stops. Measured zero is undetected; no positive detections gives missing conditional intensity. No-support depth strata remain missing. Retain uncertain labels in inventory and allQC sensitivity.
multiplicity: Ten genes, four fixed pairs and named sensitivities all reported. No p values, score, refit, state relabeling or outcome-based threshold change.
precision_basis: Twelve exposed patient pairs: individual values, range and leave-one-patient-out influence range; not a confidence interval, power claim or independent-cell inference.
interpretation_limit: Candidate barcode RNA only; no receptor absence, assembled proteins, IL-1 activation, macrophage source, intrinsic within-state regulation, validated malignancy/KAC or independent replication.
stop_rule: Any hash, source identity, missing/duplicate target, invalid count, QC join, primary roster or old pseudobulk parity conflict stops. Sensitivity missingness cannot change primary.
amendment_reason: New owner-authorized exposed cell distribution description follows frozen aggregate components; original prediction and unfavorable fibroblast result remain unchanged.
